newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's November copper output falls 7.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's November copper output falls 7.1 pct.

text.p: Peru's copper output fell 7.1 percent to 36,366 tonnes in November compared to the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from Energy and Mines Ministry released Friday.
Production rose 17.2 percent to 436,804 tonnes in the first 11 months of the year against the same period last year.
In 1995, copper output rose 10.8 percent to 404,990 tonnes from 365,513 tonnes in 1994.
Peru is the world's sixth largest copper producer. Its biggest producer, Southern Peru Copper Corp, accounts for around 60 percent of the country's output.
